name: review_item_status
description: Review queue workflow status, independent of finding validity.

definitions.confirmed: Deprecated spelling of accepted, retained for historical payloads.
definitions.rejected: Rejected by an actual review, not an administrative bulk closure.
definitions.accepted: Accepted by an actual review; this is not a finding validity value.
definitions.closed_unreviewed: Closed administratively without an acceptance or rejection from a review.

confirmed.note: Readers interpret historical confirmed as accepted. New writers switch only after core enforcement and reader compatibility are ready.
